summary: Port rigid-body contact adjacency counting and atomic ID scatter, composed with the native ordered prefix hierarchy.
regressions: 33 cases cover empty inputs, contact/workgroup/body-scan boundaries, multiple interleaved batches and grid-stride loops
Zero-length gaps with stale maximum body IDs; static, partially locked, multibody and self-contact membership
Exact row counts and ID multisets reject missing, duplicate or misplaced contributions while allowing legal atomic reorderings
Ordered count/scan/scatter uses persistent GPU buffers; guards, input fields and inactive scratch are checked
differences: No Rust physics changes or float tolerance changes. Atomic scatter order is intentionally not compared byte-for-byte inside active rows.
The multibody flag is honored as a filter; articulated multibody solving remains explicitly deferred.
The composed program receives reset counts as the production cleanup stage provides; complete production frame and color scheduling remain pending.
Ascend checks certify source lowering only, not CANN compilation or device execution.
